# `layout.place`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/layout.place.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`layout.place` (`PlaceDevice`, D6, doc 12 §3.3): places a device on a rail or on a mounting surface at an explicit
pose, or, with `mode` on a rail, where the mode resolves it (WP-S4.02 D4, D5).

Without `mode` the pose is taken exactly as given. With `mode` on a rail the pose's `t.x` is the intended clip
point: free keeps it where the device fits with its minimum gaps (clearance pads, end brackets) else takes the
nearest position where it fits; push inserts it and moves the placements to its right, each as far as its minimum
gap requires, in the same transaction; swap is refused (the device is on no rail yet). With `mode` on a surface only
`free` is accepted and means the explicit pose. The mode's refusals name the rail by its label and the devices by
their tags ("No gap on rail 1 is wide enough for F55 (18 mm).", "Pushing would move -102F2, which is locked.",
"Pushing would move S51 past the rail end by 20 mm.").

The placement always records the part use it realises: the given `part` (a copy the device uses; its use's
reference is copied, variant included), else the device's primary mountable part at this moment (the first part
use whose part mounts, else the first without a mount kind; D8); a strip with terminals and a device without a part
record none. `function` places one function of the device separately.

Rejected: a device, carrier or surface that does not exist (`/device`, `/carrier`); a function that does not exist
or is not the device's (`/function`); a part the device does not use (`/part`); a second placement of one (device,
part, function); a part whose mount kind does not fit the rail's profile (the table of `ew_derive::layout`); a pose
outside the carrier kind's degrees of freedom (a rail: `t = (s, 0, 0)` turned 0° or 180°; a surface: `t = (u, v,
0)` turned `k · 90°`; a duct carries none) or off the rail (`s ∉ [0, L]`). Interactive. Outcome: the placement.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `carrier` | [`PlaceOnParam`](#placeonparam) | yes |  | The rail or surface. |
| `device` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The device. |
| `function` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) or `null` | no |  | One function of the device placed separately. |
| `mode` | [`PlaceMode`](#placemode) or `null` | no |  | How the position is resolved on a rail: `free`, `push` or `swap` (WP-S4.02 D5); absent: the pose as given. |
| `part` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) or `null` | no |  | The part copy of the part use to realise; default the primary mountable part. |
| `pose` | [`CmdPose3`](#cmdpose3) | yes |  | The pose relative to the carrier; with `mode` on a rail, `t.x` is the intended clip point. |

## Types

### CmdPose3

A pose: the translation t = [x, y, z] in nanometres and the rotation q = [w, x, y, z], a sign-normalised unit quaternion in 10^-9 (doc 05 §3.2).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | array of (integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000), integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000), integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000), integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000)) (at least 4 item(s), at most 4 item(s)) | yes |  |  |
| `t` | array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 3 item(s), at most 3 item(s)) | yes |  |  |

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### PlaceMode

How `layout.place` and `layout.move` resolve their position on a rail (WP-S4.02 D4, D5). Without a mode the pose
is taken exactly as given.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"free"` | The placement stays where it fits with its minimum gaps, else goes to the nearest position where it fits; nothing else moves. On a surface: the explicit pose. |
| `"push"` | The placement is inserted; the placements to its right move right as far as their minimum gaps require. |
| `"swap"` | The placement exchanges places with the placement under its centre on the same rail. |

### PlaceOnParam

What a placement sits on (D3): `{"carrier": id}` (a rail) or `{"surface": id}` (the plate itself).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A rail (a duct carries no placements).

   Shape: object { `carrier`: [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `carrier` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2). |

2. **Form 2**: The mounting surface itself.

   Shape: object { `surface`: [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `surface` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2). |

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
